free_tier.stated: 10 TB storage on Premium; additional storage purchasable

egress.terms: HARD METERED, and worse for programmatic use. Verbatim from help centre: base quotas are 'Cloud Download: 40 TB per month. Downstream: 4 TB per month, including playback, previews, and downloads. Upload: 1 TB per month.' And 'Connected Apps share a combined transfer quota limit equal to 25% of your monthly Transfer Quota, across all three traffic dimensions.' So rclone/WebDAV/CLI — the only programmatic paths — get 25% of 4 TB = 1 TB/month downstream.

interface_detail: WebDAV (read-only, premium-only, 'experimental'), official CLI, rclone backend
tooling: rclone 'pikpak' backend exists; WebDAV is read-only and flagged incomplete by the vendor
chaining: rclone; CLI; NOT a general object store
limits_note: Connected-Apps cap = 25% of monthly quota; free accounts also have a 20 GB/day downstream limit
reliability_note: The storage price is a decoy; the product is a BT/magnet cache.

extras.price_verbatim: $0.833/TB/mo at 10 TB ($99.99/yr Global Premium). Usable programmatic egress is 1 TB/month (25% × 4 TB downstream). Effective cost per TB actually retrievable per month is fine, but the ceiling makes it unusable for serving or bulk restore. Reject on egress, not on price.
